senses.gloss: f. (πέτρα) rock. Y’lamd. to Num. XXIII, 9 quot. in Ar.; Yalk. Num. 766 חפר … יהיה מוצא למטה פ׳ he dug in one place and found a rock below; ib. הרי מצאתי פ׳ לבנות וכ׳ I have found a rock (Abraham) on which to build and establish the world.
